findings.F1: The test's result points the way the idea predicts but stops short of the bar: the slope t is 1.91 on 429 grid days with a directional mean excess of +0.41 %. Its size is small: the unusual move is +0.67 % per case over 5 days (t 1.98 over 1171 days), 0.035 of the coin's usual 12.35 % move. All 19 coins and all four folds were already used, so there is no more 1d data to add.
findings.F2: In folds B and C, the effect sits in calm choppy bars and not in agitated ones.
findings.F3: The effect is uneven over time.
findings.F6: The horizon is roughly right but could be longer. In B and C the slope t is 1.44 at 1 day, 2.00 at 3 days, 2.11 at 5 days, 2.30 at 10 days and 1.44 at 20 days. Over 15 days in calm bars it is only 0.07.

ideas.idea: In a choppy, calm market, the more of its own 20-day daily swings a coin's 20-day rise spans, the more it rises over the next 5 days.
ideas.consequence: A trader would follow a multi-week move measured in the coin's own swings only when the coin is both range-bound and quieter than usual for it, and stand aside when it is agitated.
ideas.name: choppy calm swing continuation
